compatibilityRule: A root operation may not become less authenticated or change its authorization profile in v1. Tightening an existing gate can also break callers and requires explicit compatibility review.

authentication.requiredMeaning: A valid Atom bearer/access token or trusted auth cookie must produce AuthContext before the resolver accesses protected data.
authentication.sessionCredentialRequiredMeaning: Normal authentication plus a non-null JWT session id; API-key/access-token authentication is rejected for this operation.

authorizationProfiles.public: No AuthContext. signup remains separately gated by ATOM_SELF_REGISTRATION_ENABLED.
authorizationProfiles.authenticated_self_service: The authenticated subject may act only on its own session, credentials, invitations, or memberships as checked by the resolver/service.
authorizationProfiles.canonical_read_gate: Authentication plus require_read_access, require_list_access, require_role_read, require_policy_read, owner/delegated read, or the canonical authorized-listing filter.
authorizationProfiles.scoped_control_plane_gate: Authentication plus an unconditional capability gate at the operation's platform, tenant, or object scope; object-specific decisions additionally use the PDP where applicable.
authorizationProfiles.platform_manage: Authentication plus unconditional manage at platform scope. Used for restore, purge, and platform hygiene operations.
authorizationProfiles.authz_decision: Authentication plus the self/delegated authz invocation rule, followed by the canonical PDP for the requested subject/action/object.
authorizationProfiles.resolver_specific: Authentication plus the resolver's frozen v1 combination of ownership, tenant membership, credential-ceiling, capability, and/or PDP checks. Focused high-risk groups are listed below; changing an unlisted gate still requires contract review.

delegatedAuthzInvocation.self: An authenticated subject may check or list its own authorization without an invocation capability; the caller's scoped-token ceiling still applies.
delegatedAuthzInvocation.delegated: A check or authorized-object listing for another subject requires authz.check in the requested object's resolved tenant scope or at platform scope. policy.manage and manage are not substitutes.

focusedParity: SDL root query/mutation names exactly match rootOperations and every operation appears in exactly one profileAssignments group.
health, login, and signup remain the only public operations.
refreshSession still requires AuthContext plus a session id.
Restore/purge operations, API endpoint administration, and signing-key administration retain explicit platform-manage gates.
Self authz checks/listings remain authenticated self-service; every delegated check/listing requires authz.check in the resolved tenant or at platform scope.

Entity update/delete have no administrative self-target bypass, honor scoped-credential ceilings, and tenant moves require both source and destination authority against a mutation-consistent tenant snapshot. updateEntity additionally exposes only the documented session-bound global-human self-profile fields.
manualReviewRequired: Resolver-specific ownership/action/scope arguments are reviewed from the named authorization helpers; the parity gate deliberately avoids whole-source hashes so compatible bug fixes remain possible.
